mapper.sql: SELECT B.BOARD_NO boardNo , B.BOARD_TITLE boardTitle , B.REG_DATE regDate , B.STATUS status , COUNT(CASE WHEN BR.STATUS = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS boardReportCount , M.MEMBER_ID memberId FROM TB_BOARD B JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON B.REF_MNO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BOARD_REPORT BR ON BR.REF_BNO = B.BOARD_NO GROUP BY B.BOARD_NO, B.BOARD_TITLE, B.REG_DATE, B.STATUS, M.MEMBER_ID

SELECT C.COMMENT_NO commentNo , C.COMMENT_CONTENT commentContent , C.REG_DATE regDate , C.STATUS status , COUNT(CASE WHEN CR.STATUS = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS commentReportCount , M.MEMBER_ID memberId FROM TB_COMMENT C JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON C.REF_MNO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_COMMENT_REPORT CR ON CR.REF_CNO = C.COMMENT_NO GROUP BY C.COMMENT_NO, C.COMMENT_CONTENT, C.REG_DATE, C.STATUS, M.MEMBER_ID
mapper.select: HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN BR.STATUS = 'Y' THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY B.BOARD_NO DESC
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN CR.STATUS = 'Y' THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY C.COMMENT_NO DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT REF_BNO) FROM TB_BOARD_REPORT WHERE STATUS = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT REF_CNO) FROM TB_COMMENT_REPORT WHERE STATUS = 'Y'
